issue.title: Percentage discount uses the whole number
issue.description: calculate_discount(100, 10) must return 90. Reproduce the existing failures and repair the implementation without changing tests.

issue.title: First page starts at the wrong offset
issue.description: paginate([1,2,3,4,5], page=1, page_size=2) must return [1,2], but the first page is skipped. Fix page offset calculation.

issue.title: Localized profiles collide in cache
issue.description: Cache keys for the same user in different locales must be distinct and stable. Repair the cache key implementation.

issue.title: String false is parsed as true
issue.description: parse_bool must handle common true/false strings case-insensitively and reject unknown values. Existing tests describe the contract.

issue.title: Reserving all remaining stock is rejected
issue.description: Inventory.reserve should allow reserving exactly the available stock while still rejecting over-reservation and invalid quantities.

issue.title: safe_divide hides programming errors
issue.description: safe_divide should return zero only for division by zero. Type errors and other programming errors must propagate.

issue.title: Retry schedule starts one exponent too late
issue.description: retry_delays(base=1, attempts=4) should produce [1,2,4,8]. Repair the schedule without changing validation.

issue.title: Percentage surcharges are applied as whole multipliers
issue.description: Both standard and express shipping totals treat percentage values as whole multipliers. Repair both implementations so 10 means ten percent.
